item.title: Expert Says XRP Could Make a Parabolic Move Most people are Not Prepared For
item.description: Historical data points to a potential upsurge for XRP as its volatility hits lows the market last witnessed in June 2024. XRP has not escaped the crypto market turbulence that began in Q4 2025, down more than 61% from its all-time high of $3.66 to the current price of $1.41.Visit Website

item.title: Document Proposes How RLUSD Could Boost XRP Price to $5
item.description: A community-generated document has proposed an avenue through which the Ripple stablecoin RLUSD could boost the XRP price to as high as $5. A document circulating in the XRP community presented a theory that institutions could use RLUSD to execute large XRP buy orders, potentially pushing prices as high as $5.00 in a staged example involving a $1 billion deposit.Visit Website

item.title: Top Investor Predicts When XRP Will Surpass Bitcoin by Magnitude

item.title: Michael Saylor Says If Bitcoin Is Not Going to Zero, It’s Going to $1 Million

item.title: Japan SBI Launches On-Chain Bonds That Instantly Reward Investors With XRP
